candidates.statement: Inventory is rejecting configuration values (21 configuration_rejections, 9 ERROR configuration_value_rejected with 503), driving its error_rate to 0.15 while gateway/order/payment stay healthy at 0.0012. The deployment record shows configuration_valid=false at revision cfg-016, consistent with a bad configuration on inventory.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone cannot establish causation; the invalid config flag is corroborated by rejection logs and elevated error rate.

report.explanation: Inventory shows the only anomaly: 21 configuration rejections, 9 ERROR configuration_value_rejected (503), error_rate 0.15 vs 0.0012 elsewhere, and configuration_valid=false at cfg-016. Other services and dependencies are healthy, so bad-configuration is the bounded, evidence-supported candidate.
